'''Kiela''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]]. She was married to [[Tosha]], but died before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The couple had two daughters.<ref name="A Necessary Evil" />
